summary: Gold X2 Mining Inc., a Vancouver-based gold explorer listed on NYSE American and TSXV, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 10, 2026, reporting assay results from its resource expansion drilling program at the Moss Gold Project in Northwest Ontario. The first two of twenty-one planned QES Deeps holes returned broad intercepts, including 173.0m of 0.89 g/t Au from 685.0m, roughly 75-100m below the current RPEEE pit shell. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or material corporate action is disclosed; this is a routine operational exploration update, not a special situation. Watch future resource estimates and drill results.
